page: City page: B2B lead generation Dubai (/b2b-lead-generation-dubai)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Dubai?
items.answer: No. Myntmore is based in BKC, Mumbai, and runs every engagement remotely. Mumbai is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE, so our working days overlap almost entirely, and UAE clients work with us over calls, shared dashboards and a weekly report.

items.question: What should I look for in a lead generation company in Dubai?
items.answer: Four things: lists built from buying signals instead of bought databases, dedicated sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, copy written for your specific buyer, and reporting that shows every reply and meeting. Ask who writes the copy and who you will speak to each week before you sign.

items.question: Which UAE businesses is this built for?
items.answer: IT, SaaS and managed service providers; distributors, trading houses and B2B service firms in facilities, logistics, insurance and recruitment; and Indian and international companies that want UAE clients or partners. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in the UAE. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending infrastructure, write copy that reads as native to UAE buyers and send in their working hours. Our UAE campaigns include managed IT services, employee benefits insurance, commercial kitchen equipment and pharma distribution partners.

items.question: Can you reach buyers elsewhere in the GCC?
items.answer: Yes. The same system can target buyers in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman and the rest of the GCC, with lists, copy and sending set up for each market. We usually recommend starting with one market and adding the next once the first is booking meetings.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days. Most clients see their first qualified conversations within 3 to 4 weeks of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building, and sequence setup are complete.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an SDR in Dubai means recruiting, a visa and months of ramp-up before they are fully productive, and one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.
